app.title: Digital Handover Room
app.subtitle: Integration gate · M3.2
app.goal: Release a trustworthy existing-conditions package for renovation planning.
app.keyboard: Use Tab to reach choices, Space or Enter to select, then submit.
intro.title: One survey. One release decision.
intro.body: A drone-derived survey of existing building conditions is needed for renovation planning. Check its source, place it in the project reference, compare it with the plan, then release only a validated and approved package.
intro.scoring: 25 points per gate. Correct released package required. Pass at 75 points.
intro.resumeNote: A saved handover is available at gate {gate}.
gate.verify.name: Verify source
gate.integrate.name: Integrate
gate.compare.name: Compare
gate.release.name: Release
gate.verify.title: Check the survey before comparison
gate.verify.prompt: Which source issue must be resolved before this dataset can be compared with the project model?
gate.verify.context: The survey captures existing conditions for a renovation comparison. Its recorded reference is different from the project's reference.
gate.integrate.title: Bring the layers into one reference
gate.integrate.prompt: What action makes the survey suitable for a consistent comparison?
gate.integrate.context: The mismatch has been flagged. The survey layer is still offset from the project model until its placement is resolved.
gate.compare.title: Find the meaningful difference
gate.compare.prompt: Which difference between planned and existing conditions needs a project review?
gate.compare.context: The layers now share the project reference. Compare the planned opening with the survey points. Other display differences are representation details.
gate.compare.choose: Select a feature on the overlay
gate.release.title: Choose the controlled release
gate.release.prompt: Which package can be released to the shared renovation workflow?
gate.release.context: The opening discrepancy has been recorded for review. Check version, alignment, QA and approval together.
gate.revise: Adjust your selection and try again.
gate.scoreHint: Mistakes reduce points for this gate; a correction still clears it.

feedback.verify.correct: The source mismatch is flagged. Spatial references must be made consistent before geometry is compared.
feedback.verify.ready: The reference labels differ. A direct comparison could make a placement error look like a building difference.
feedback.verify.units: The units are recorded. Recheck the survey reference against the project reference.
feedback.verify.tryAgain: Check the recorded survey and project references.
feedback.integrate.correct: The survey is aligned to the project reference with a traceable placement. The comparison layer is now unlocked.
feedback.integrate.drag: A visual drag is not a verified placement. The survey needs a consistent, documented project reference.
feedback.integrate.asis: The layers are offset. Comparing them now could turn a placement artefact into a false discrepancy.
feedback.integrate.tryAgain: Choose a documented action that resolves the reference mismatch.
feedback.compare.correct: The opening location differs between planned and existing layers. Record it for project review without inferring a structural cause.
feedback.compare.density: Point spacing changes the survey's appearance, but it is not the planned-versus-existing geometry difference shown here.
feedback.compare.style: Different display styles do not by themselves show a change in building geometry. Compare the opening locations.
feedback.compare.tryAgain: Compare the same building feature in both layers.
feedback.release.correct: The current aligned package has passed QA, includes the discrepancy record, and is approved. It can be released.
feedback.release.old: This package has approval but is superseded. Release the current approved information.
feedback.release.draft: The latest revision is still a draft. Its alignment and approval have not been cleared.
feedback.release.qa: A current label cannot override unresolved spatial placement or failed QA.
feedback.release.tryAgain: Check current version, spatial alignment, QA and approval together.
diagram.title: Planned model and existing survey overlay
diagram.unaligned: Survey offset / not ready for comparison
diagram.description.unaligned: Planned building outline and survey points are visibly offset. This offset is a spatial integration issue, not a building discrepancy.
diagram.description.aligned: Planned and survey building outlines align. A planned rectangular opening and the existing opening point cluster sit at different horizontal positions.
result.pass.title: Package released
result.pass.body: The survey was checked, aligned, compared and released from the current approved information package.
result.fail.title: Handover needs another attempt
result.fail.body: The final package was valid, but the score is below the 75-point pass mark. Review the gate feedback and replay to improve the result.
